entries.15914101b8e86995: A reportable segment that provides group classes for elementary and junior high school students, individual tutoring and video-lesson (iD Yobiko) study and admissions guidance for elementary through high school students, various courses and mock tests, English classrooms for children, after-school childcare and early childhood education. The consolidated subsidiary Higashi Nihon Gakuin Co., Ltd. also operates cram schools and preparatory schools in Fukushima Prefecture. Sales to external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥9,349 million.
entries.1daae2df5b5cf80e: Since its founding in 1984, it has built an integrated education system spanning elementary, junior high and high school, based in Shizuoka Prefecture. Its distinctive features are the acquisition of students from the lower grades through the Shizuoka Prefecture Unified Test, a public mock examination across the prefecture, and the Public Ability Test for elementary school students, and an instructional approach combining group classes, individual tutoring and video lessons.
entries.2b9709120c0561b1: Its main targets are elementary school, junior high school and high school students and high school graduates, and it provides education services through classes at its campuses as well as online learning guidance, various intensive courses, mock tests and after-school childcare.
